text:
ezra_support: heads up — acme-inc hit brief 429 storm last night ~02:17 UTC. Customer says they had burst credits but saw ~120 429s in a 3m window. stacktrace + headers attached.

maria_cs: thanks. can you paste the request headers and their reported token usage? also which org id?

ezra_support: org: acme-inc (org_983). headers from one failed request:
```
x-request-id: rq_01AB
x-burst-credits: 0
x-burst-window: 60
x-rate-limit-reset: 17000000
```
payload was batch of 10 short completions (avg 12 tokens each). They normally do 5rps, spiked to ~35rps for ~2m.

kevin_sre: quick note — `x-burst-credits: 0` means cushion exhausted. Smoothing policy probably drained cushion then applied asymmetric throttle. Do we have the refill timeline?

ezra_support: customer logs show credits dropped to 0 at 02:15:12, then a sharp spike, then a slow refill. They expected fractional refill quicker — reported seeing full refill only after ~40m.

jon_eng: fractional refill is usually continuous at rate = refill_rate tokens/sec (configured per plan). but there are min refill quantum and bucket interval hops. can you run `rbx admin credits-inspect org_983 --since "2025-11-02T02:00:00Z"` and paste output?

ezra_support: ran it, snippet below:
```
2025-11-02T02:14:55Z credits=8
2025-11-02T02:15:12Z credits=0 -> throttle start
2025-11-02T02:20:30Z credits=1
2025-11-02T02:40:00Z credits=24
```
so refill appears very gradual.

kevin_sre: that refill profile suggests smoothing window too wide or fractional refill quantum small. Two quick mitigations: 1) bump cushion (temporary top-up) 2) reduce smoothing window / increase refill quantum in policy so short spikes recover faster.

maria_cs: customer asked for immediate workaround. can we do a one-off top-up and also propose config change?

jon_eng: yes — I can issue a +50 credits emergency top-up (`rbx admin credits-topup org_983 50 --note "support emergency"`). For config, recommend: `smoothing.enabled = true`, `smoothing.window = 30s`, `smoothing.refill_rate = 2.0` (tokens/sec) and `smoothing.min_quantum = 0.5`.

ezra_support: did top-up go through? customer still online and testing.

redwood-bot: credits-topup executed by jon_eng — +50 credits applied to org_983 (tx_98765)

maria_cs: customer reports 429s dropped to ~2 over next 10min, then back to normal. they're happy to try policy change in staging before prod.

kevin_sre: opened infra ticket INF-2025-991 to track smoothing tuning + telemetry improvements (we should show fractional refill per minute in console). assigning to eng-runtime.

ezra_support: summary for customer: 1) spike exhausted burst cushion -> 429s, 2) fractional refill is gradual by design but can be tuned, 3) we applied emergency top-up and will propose smoothing policy tweak for staging. follow-up scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: adding recommended docs link: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/burst-credits#smoothing and attaching reproduction steps for our eng team.

jon_eng: reproduction steps we saved:
1) generate traffic: `hey loadgen --rps 35 --duration 120 --batch 10`
2) monitor `rbx admin credits-inspect org_983 --live`
3) observe `x-burst-credits` header and `429` rate

ezra_support: closing the loop with customer now. will keep thread updated if anything else crops up.
